messages:
Morgan: Hey team — opening a docs PR to add a minimal install playbook focused on private/on‑prem networking fallbacks and a small set of copy‑paste examples (NAT, minimal nftables/iptables fallback, IPv6 opt‑out, offline cert sync). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4572
Sam: grabbing this now. Quick engineering checklist: confirm port matrix entries for KMS<->HSM and installer agent, and add explicit conntrack/sysctl notes for high‑throughput sites. Also prefer showing both nftables and iptables examples (one minimal each). :+1:
Sam: snippet for conntrack/sysctl we should include (minimal):
```
# increase conntrack table size for heavy flows
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144
# reduce timeouts for established TCP (example)
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=300
```
Priya: Security check — add a short HSM/KMS hardening note: disable core dumps for process users, ensure PKCS#11 sockets have restrictive perms, and document NTP/chrony requirement. Also call out an HSM retry/backoff recommendation (don’t hammer PKCS#11 on startup).
Priya: Suggested wording for cert validation paragraph: "Ensure the KMS cert chain is installed on the appliance and that the installer verifies the chain before bootstrapping. For air‑gapped sites, provide an offline bundle and a checksum; see the offline cert sync script below."
Lee: I can add an IPv6 toggle example and a tiny offline cert sync helper (scp + systemd timer) to the PR. Draft script (will polish in PR):
```
#!/bin/sh
# sync-offline-certs.sh - minimal: copy cert bundle into /etc/redwood/certs
set -e
scp -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no user@staging-box:/tmp/redwood-certs.tar.gz /tmp/
mkdir -p /etc/redwood/certs
tar -xzf /tmp/redwood-certs.tar.gz -C /etc/redwood/certs
chown -R redwood:redwood /etc/redwood/certs
```
Lee: IPv6 toggle example (config snippet):
```
# installer.yaml fragment
network:
  enable_ipv6: false  # set true to enable dual-stack
  nat_for_ipv4: true
```
Morgan: Nice. Two minor docs UX asks: 1) include short Table of Contents anchors at top for "Ports", "Firewall examples", "Offline certs", "IPv6"; 2) fix the broken anchor we discovered on the install checklist (current link points to #network-check but should be #networking-check).
Sam: FYI I checked the port list — adding this to PR: TCP 443 (installer/KMS), TCP 5696 (HSM PKCS#11), UDP 123 (NTP), 22 only for maintenance in airgapped mode. Will append a small table.
DevBot: docs-build-bot: build passed for PR #4572 — preview at https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood-inference.internal/4572/ :white_check_mark:
Morgan: Great. Outstanding items: Sam to add port table + nft/iptables pair, Priya to add security blurb + NTP note, Lee to add scripts and IPv6 toggle, small TOC + anchor fix. Can everyone review the PR today? :eyes:
Priya: Reviewing now, will ping with wording tweaks.
Sam: Expect a small commit shortly (adding port table).
Lee: uploading script + systemd timer in next push.
Morgan: Thanks — once merged, I'll update the migration guide index to link to this playbook. :thumbsup:
